info.title: Digital Card Framework
info.description: Headless card framework. Production host uses verified OIDC sessions, exact-origin JSON writes, X-DC-Principal account binding and immutable trade review. Operator routes are opt-in and require server-derived authority.

hostSession.name: __Host-dc_session
hostSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly/Secure cookie issued by the production OIDC host; adapters may replace the session resolver.

adminRevision.description: Administration revision from the reviewed quote. Stale prices or odds require a new quote.

expectedDigest.description: Required by production review policy; SHA-256 digest of the immutable offer.

provenance.description: Immutable source, definition hashes and pack/slot snapshots. Legacy reconstruction explicitly marks unknown historical fields.

type.description: Built-in type or declared namespaced custom type.

metadataSchemas.description: Bounded local schema subset for card metadata, variant metadata and stats; no external refs, regex or executable tags.

policyRevision.description: Required once policy administration has changed; commit must match the review.

generator.description: Installed synchronous server code factory. Immutable after pool creation.

redeemUrl.description: HTTPS URL without credentials. Never include a secret code.

probability.description: Numerator cannot exceed denominator. One draw per slot, not per card.

params.description: Public bounded parameters for a server-installed handler; never source code or credentials.

ListingStock.description: Existing stock requires ids. Mint sources require quantity and variantId/productId. Custom stock requires quantity and installed handler. Only admin shops with commerce.manage may issue new/custom stock.

ActionJob.description: Sanitized delivery history; no executable params, provider output or lease token.

requiredWhen.description: Bounded expression: field, exists, not, eq, comparisons, and/or, arithmetic.

calculate.description: Bounded numeric expression; source must be calculated.

items.description: Nested field constraints; key and label are optional.

at.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

createdAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

oneOf.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

preparedAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

fulfilledAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

refundRequiredAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

cancelledAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

compensatedAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

quarantinedAt.description: Parseable timestamp returned by the trusted host clock.

adminRevision.description: Administration revision from the reviewed quote. Stale prices or odds require a new quote.

expectedDigest.description: Required by production review policy; SHA-256 digest of the immutable offer.

policyRevision.description: Required once policy administration has changed; commit must match the review.
